verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is scheduled to return to Earth on Friday, April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'splashdown off the coast of San Diego, California on Friday, April 10, around 8:07 p.m.'; R4: 'Orion will come home Friday (April 10)'; R5: 'Orion will splash down ... off the coast of San Diego at 8:07 p.m. ET today [April 10, 2026]'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the scheduled return/splashdown date as Friday, April 10, 2026.

verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe Artemis II as a 10-day mission involving a lunar flyby/orbit.
